metadata.title: Account Preferences Review
metadata.description: A settings form used to verify form-field fidelity and password redaction.

blocks.text: This page verifies that every kind of form field a capture can encounter is preserved as a record: text, email, password, checkbox, radio, select, and textarea. The password value must never reach any published artifact.

blocks.text: A capture is an act of record. The state of every control on the page is part of what the page said, so each field above must appear in the bundle with its name and value — except the password, whose value is replaced by a redaction marker before it can reach any artifact.
